notes: Who the company meets in the field, as parameters (owner call, 2026-10-27): everything is a weight the seeded draw selects with, nothing is a guarantee, except the one rule in entranceBuilder. Read by verdance.company.encounters (the encounter field) and the fixed-homes fallback in verdance.company.company.field_recruits_for_map. The mission builder asks Python and never picks recruits itself.

markedGround.notes: A wild hero believed on a zone the company marked (target, pad) is that many times likelier to be drawn. Attention, not a seat.

homeZone.notes: How strongly a hero's authored home zone pulls their meeting place, by why they are tied to it. 'fixed' pins them there (a hero who does not walk cannot be met anywhere else); a number multiplies the home zone's haunt weight (1.0 = an ordinary hero). The home map pulls with homeMapHaunt.

entranceBuilder.notes: The one hard rule: on the Rock Jungle, a builder hero waits at the entrance. The Consul while the company does not have him; once he is with the company, another wild hero who builds economy (crew_packs heroes buildsEco), drawn by the same weights.

meetingStance.notes: How a met hero turns up (owner calls 2026-10-27/28; continuous, no thresholds). stance = the bond web's edges between the hero and everyone in the company (allies +, rivalry/tension/friction -; an authored edge 1.0, a derived one half its score; deepened by bond points earned together). pHostile = 1 / (1 + exp((stance + bias) / softness)); a seeded roll under it spawns the hero alive on the enemy's side, like the Kiln (put them down, raise the wreck); otherwise they come their authored way (a wreck, for most). bias slides from 'bias' to 'biasLate' between missions rampFrom and rampTo. Lower bias = more hostility everywhere; smaller softness = sharper.

presence.notes: How much a relation to someone in the company raises the chance of meeting a wild hero, per side (umwelt.foresight.encounter Weights presence_ally / presence_adversary). Owner call 2026-10-28: bonds are the default meeting, rivals the accent, strangers uncommon. Measured (6 maps x 20 seeds, 2 met per map): Pavise/Solarium/Halbard met 59% bonded, 9% rivals (only 2 in the pool), 32% strangers; Vane/Quill/Kettle 65% bonded, 21% rivals, 15% strangers. 'relation' is the shared weight an older Umwelt uses (no per-side weights).

fieldFit.notes: Field effects v2 (2026-10-29): a wild hero with no written tie to the company is drawn by each party hero whose aura would reach them, or whose aura would reach that party hero (field_effects.json tags and axes; auras that reach everyone do not count). The relation is an ally-side link at weight x hits (umwelt reads an unknown polarity as ally x0.5). It decides which strangers turn up, not how many. Measured at 0.2 (6 maps x 20 seeds, mission 3, 2 met per map): Pavise/Solarium/Halbard 79% bonded, 9% rivals, 12% strangers (8 points of it fitting; was 82/10/8); Vane/Quill/Kettle 78/5/17 (8 fitting; was 79/5/16); Yeva/Veil/Vale 59/3/38 (27 fitting; was 62/5/32).
